desc:
🎈 CAN YOU ESCAPE FROM THE BACKROOMS? 🎈

You have appeared in the Backrooms: infinite yellow corridors, flickering lights, and something is looking for you... 👀

🤡 Mini Mini, the monstrous clown, travels through every level. If he finds you, you lose.

🐸 Your mission: Find Bufo and take him to the elevator before Mini Mini catches you.

⭐ FEATURES ⭐
🏢 Various levels to explore
📜 Different missions at each level
🤫 Hide, run, and don't make any noise
🐸 Rescue Bufo
👥 Play with friends
😱 Mild horror, suitable for everyone

👍 Like and Favorite to stay updated with new releases!
